title: Caution · new reading
text: {measurement} is outside your normal values. Re-check in {recheck_minutes} minutes before taking action.

title: Caution for 3 days
text: {measurement} has been in Caution for 3 days. Your medical team has been told automatically. You don't have to do anything.

title: Warning · act now
text: {measurement} is in the red range. Follow the steps now.
spoken_text: Warning. {measurement} is high. Open the action card.

title: Low reading
text: {measurement} is lower than usual. This can be normal for you. Tell us if you feel dizzy or faint.

title: Old reading · {days} days
text: Your last {measurement} is {days} days old. Measure again when you can.

title: No signal
text: Spica works offline. Act now; do not wait for a reply. Reports send themselves when the link returns.

title: Radiation · 25% of career limit
text: You have reached a quarter of your career radiation limit (600 mSv). Nothing to do now.

title: Radiation · 50% of career limit
text: Half of your career limit. Your medical team will plan to keep extra exposure low.

title: Radiation · 80% of career limit
text: You are close to your career limit. Tell your medical team.

title: Solar storm · level S1
text: A minor solar radiation storm. No spacewalks will be planned for now.

title: Solar storm · go to shelter
text: A solar radiation storm (level S2 or higher). Stop what you are doing and go to the shielded area.
spoken_text: Warning. Solar storm. Go to shelter.
evidence_level: consensus (S-scale); demo (S2 trigger, approved by team)

title: Cabin CO₂ rising
text: Cabin CO₂ is between 2.5 and 3 mmHg. If you have a headache, move to a better ventilated area and report it.

title: Cabin CO₂ high
text: Cabin CO₂ is above 3 mmHg (1-hour average). Report it now and open the guide if you have a headache.

title: Suit CO₂ rising
text: Slow down and breathe steadily.

title: Suit CO₂ high
text: Open the purge valve as trained and tell the crew.
spoken_text: Warning. Suit CO2 high. Purge as trained.

title: Suit pressure
text: Suit pressure is outside its normal range. Follow your suit procedure and head back to the airlock.
spoken_text: Warning. Suit pressure. Follow suit procedure.

title: Time to go back
text: You are into your reserve time. Head back to the airlock now.
spoken_text: Warning. Reserve time. Return to airlock.

title: Emergency guide open
text: Every step is being recorded for your report.

title: Critical value · {measurement}
text: {measurement} reached a critical value. The action card is open.

title: Change from your normal · {measurement}
text: {measurement} has been outside your personal band on {n} of the last 6 days. See the evidence.
evidence_level: demo (rule); consensus (Appendix F link to evidence)

title: Missing data · {measurement}
text: No {measurement} for {days} days. Analysis confidence is lower.

title: Event on this day
text: {event} happened on this day. Changes may be related.

title: Report ready
text: Your report ({kb} KB) will go with the next downlink.
